title: Patterns and Sorting for Kids! Learn with Bloop
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Bloop, and welcome to Bloop's Color Lab!
Today we're making patterns and sorting things into groups!
I put on my lab goggles, and I'm ready to learn something new with you.
Can you count with me? One, two, three, four, five!
Ready? Let's wiggle into the lab!

lines: Here's a clue: red, blue, red, blue... what comes next? Can you guess?
This is a Color Pattern! A pattern repeats, again and again.
Red, blue, red, blue, red... blue! Blue comes next.
Red, blue, red, blue. It goes on and on!
Can you clap a pattern? Clap, stomp, clap, stomp!
Can you guess? What pattern is hiding up high?
Yellow, green, yellow, green! Another pattern.
Let's say it together: COLOR PATTERN!
One more time, nice and loud: COLOR PATTERN! Great job!
Patterns are everywhere, like the stripes on a shirt.
Bye-bye, Color Pattern! See you soon!
Here's a clue: circle, square, circle, square... what comes next? Can you guess?
This is a Shape Pattern! The shapes take turns.
Circle, square, circle, square, circle... square! A square comes next.
Round circle, then a square with four sides. Again and again!
Can you make a pattern? Hands up, hands down, hands up, hands down!
Can you guess? Which shapes are taking turns up high?
Star, heart, star, heart! Another shape pattern.
Let's say it together: SHAPE PATTERN!
One more time, nice and loud: SHAPE PATTERN! Great job!
You can make patterns with blocks, beads, and even sounds.
Bye-bye, Shape Pattern! See you soon!
Here's a clue: red things and blue things got all mixed up! Can you guess?
Let's Sort by Color! Same color goes together.
Red things go in the red basket. An apple, a heart, a ball!
Red with red. Look how tidy!
Can you point to something red, and something blue, near you?
Can you guess? Where do the blue things go?
In the blue basket! A blue ball, a star, and a fish.
Let's say it together: SORT BY COLOR!
One more time, nice and loud: SORT BY COLOR! Great job!
Sorting helps us keep our toys neat and easy to find.
Bye-bye, Sort by Color! See you soon!
Here's a clue: some things are round, and some have four corners! Can you guess?
Let's Sort by Shape! Same shape goes together.
Circles go in the circle basket. Round, round, round!
Red, blue, and purple, but they're all circles.
Can you draw a circle in the air? Now draw a square!
Can you guess? Where do the squares go?
In the square basket! Four sides and four corners each.
Let's say it together: SORT BY SHAPE!
One more time, nice and loud: SORT BY SHAPE! Great job!
We can sort by color, or by shape. You choose!
Bye-bye, Sort by Shape! See you soon!
Here's a clue: three friends, all different sizes! Can you guess?
Let's go from Small to Big! Small, medium, big.
Look at their stars. A small star, a medium star, and a big star!
The middle size is called medium.
Can you make yourself small, then medium, then big?
Can you guess? Which hat fits the biggest friend?
The biggest hat! Every friend gets a hat that fits.
Let's say it together: SMALL TO BIG!
One more time, nice and loud: SMALL TO BIG! Great job!
Putting things from small to big is a kind of sorting, too.
Bye-bye, Small to Big! See you soon!

recap: Red, blue, red, blue makes a pattern.
Circle, square, circle, square makes a pattern too.
We sorted red things and blue things.
And we lined up small, medium and big!
outro: Can you sort your toys by color or by shape at home? Have fun making patterns, too.
Bye, friends! See you in the lab!
